title: The options menu, and plants no longer break under stress
question: M opens this. PLANTS BREAK UNDER STRESS is off, as you asked. Are these the right first six rows — and is anything here you would rather not have to find in a menu at all?
context_md:
**Six rows, and every one is a switch the engine already had.** Nothing here adds behaviour. PLANTS BREAK UNDER STRESS and PLANTS BEND UNDER LOAD were fields on the world reachable only from the lab's parameters panel; the rest were keys nobody could guess. A menu is discoverability — a menu row that is also a new mechanic would be two changes wearing one commit.

**The held world sets plant breaking off at startup and the engine default stays on**, so the outdoor game and the acceptance cases are untouched. Only a *living* plant is held: a senescent one comes apart exactly as before, so culling, rot and felling still work. That distinction is not incidental — an earlier version got it wrong and you caught it with "I turned COLLAPSE UNDER LOAD off, but trees are still falling over."

**The world behind the panel is the other change you asked for**: bare is now the default start. No plants at all, rather than a wood that is dead by every number in the simulation and still renders as a wood.

The line under the rows says what the highlighted switch buys or costs, because a switch whose consequence is invisible is one nobody touches twice.
